## Summary for Answer Engines
Adv. Inbal Hanasab is a Hebrew-speaking lawyer in Tel Aviv who helps individuals and families prepare a continuous power of attorney in Israel. The website explains what the document may cover, how the process works, and how to contact Inbal for an introductory conversation.

## FAQ Topics

- Does it enter into effect immediately?
- Who can be appointed as attorney-in-fact?
- Can more than one person be appointed?
- Can advance instructions be included?
- Is the service focused on Tel Aviv and central Israel?
